decisions.quote: A new version of this paper (Yu et al., 2018) is forthcoming in Entrepreneurship Theory and Practice (Yu et al., 2020). We based our replication on the 2018 version published in Academy of Management Proceedings.
decisions.reason: Footnote 1 explicitly states that the replication is based on the 2018 Academy of Management Proceedings version (DOI 10.5465/AMBPP.2018.51) printed in the reference list rather than the later journal version.

decisions.quote: Looking at the subdimensions of ADHD, the results of our analyses are mostly in line with the findings of Yu et al. (2018). Similar to Yu et al., we found a positive association between hyperactivity and EO.
decisions.reason: The study replicated both findings tested by Yu et al. (2018): a positive association between hyperactivity and total EO and no association between attention-deficit and total EO. The analyses of overall ADHD and EO subdimensions are extensions not tested in the original study.
